_note: Nameplate layout, in 1920x1080 pixels; offsets are from the nameplate's top left. Font sizes are point sizes; max_size is the width a text is squeezed into. Colours are [r, g, b, a] from 0 to 255.

titles._note: Per title plate folder (Textures/Title/<n>/): frame_count is the last frame file's number (0 = a single 0.png); effect is "flash" (the star flash, needs Small.png and Big.png) or "none". A folder not listed has one frame and no effect.

stars._note: Per rarity star folder (Textures/Stars/<n>/): frame_count is the last frame file's number. A folder not listed has one frame.

plate_only._note: Draw modes 1 and 2 (a dan or title plate alone) place the nameplate at the given point plus this offset.

rarity_stars._note: The rarity star overlay is drawn offset_y above the title plate. spots: per overlay (1, 2 or 3 stars; the 4-star overlay uses the 3-star spots), each star's [centre x, centre y, sprite width, clockwise rotation in degrees] in the overlay. Each star's glitter patch is half its width plus spot_padding around its centre. glint_offsets are the two glints' [x, y] beside a star of glint_base_w width, turned and scaled with each star.
